definitions.gloss: to install, to attach, to fit
definitions.explanation: To install equipment or attach something to a fixed position. Often used for mounting devices, fixtures, or appliances.
To successfully obtain an appointment, meeting, or promise from someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We had the air conditioner installed.
I attached the shelf to the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}→防犯：08192_bouhan⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I installed a security camera at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面会|めんかい}→面会：15925_menkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I secured an appointment for a meeting with the president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I secured a contract from the publisher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to secure a promise of cooperation from the other party.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Intransitive pair: ⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}く→取り付く：29401_toritsuku⟧.

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) + ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach).

PARTICLES: In sense 1 the thing installed takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and the place it is fixed to takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. In sense 2 the person the promise is obtained from takes ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧.

SENSE 2: The 'secure a promise/appointment' sense is common in business and news writing, where it implies the agreement took some effort to obtain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (install an air conditioner)
・⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (install a shelf)
・⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (install a sensor)
・⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (secure a promise)
・⟦アポ→アポ：06668_apo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (secure an appointment)

RELATED: ⟦{取|と}り{外|はず}す→取り外す：06161_torihazusu⟧ (to remove/detach) is the opposite action.
